meta.name: requesting-code-review
meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在合并前自动检查代码是否满足需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并代码前确保工作符合要求
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify code meets requirements before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your code meets requirements before merging

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会派遣一个代码审查子智能体，只提供精心构建的上下文（不含历史对话），来检查代码问题并报告结果。
howto.when: 当完成任务、实现主要功能后，或合并代码到主分支前触发。可选在卡住、重构前也可用。

say.text: 代码写完了，帮我审查一下。
say.note: Claude 会启动审查流程，返回问题列表。

say.text: 合并前请运行代码审查。
say.note: 确保代码质量，避免遗漏问题。
使用当前分支与上次提交的差异进行审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude dispatches a code reviewer subagent with precisely crafted context (not session history) to catch issues before they cascade.
howto.when_en: Triggered after completing a task, implementing a major feature, or before merging to main. Optionally when stuck or before refactoring.

say_en.text: I've finished coding. Please review it.
say_en.note: Claude starts the review and returns issues.

say_en.text: Run a code review before merging.
say_en.note: Ensures code quality and catches problems.
Uses diff between current HEAD and previous commit.
